requirement_structuring.structuring_summary: The original requirement intermingles a functional obligation (informing the security service) with a quality attribute (response time). Per Pohl (2025) §25.2, this is decomposed into two distinct structured artefacts: a functional requirement for the notification action and a quality requirement for the timing constraint.

source_fragments: If the glass break detector of a window detects the pane has been damaged, the system shall inform the security service.

fields.condition: The glass break detector detects that a window pane has been damaged
fields.system_or_component: Building security and alarm monitoring system

structured_requirements.final_statement: The building security and alarm monitoring system shall inform the external emergency response service (security service) when the glass break detector detects a damaged window pane.
structuring_notes: Extracted the functional obligation from the original sentence, removing the temporal constraint to isolate the core action.

fields.condition: Alarm notification is sent after damage detection
fields.system_or_component: Building security and alarm monitoring system

structured_requirements.final_statement: The alarm notification must be sent within 2 seconds after damage detection.
structuring_notes: Extracted the quality attribute (response time) as a separate requirement to satisfy the 'concern_mixing' structural issue.
